fns.desc: tls_connection_init(): if gnutls_credentials_set() fails (:263) or gnutls_certificate_allocate_credentials() fails (:271), the function os_free(conn) and returns NULL without calling gnutls_deinit(conn->session) - conn->session was already successfully initialized by tls_gnutls_init_session() and is leaked on both error paths.

tls_connection_verify_peer(): if os_malloc(len+1) fails, 'buf' stays NULL but the code still calls wpa_printf(MSG_DEBUG, "...: %s", ..., buf) unconditionally with a %s conversion on the NULL buf - real UB on most libcs, same genuine bug class as the eap_sim_db.c %s-NULL findings (rare OOM-only trigger).

server_ocsp_status_req(): on gnutls_malloc(len) failure, the code calls os_free(resp) - but 'resp' is a gnutls_datum_t* output parameter owned by the GnuTLS library caller (not allocated by this function), so freeing it is an invalid free of memory this function does not own. Low-probability (OOM-only) trigger.
